title: Finite RGO program with absorbing terminal states and actual trajectories
source_anchor: arXiv:2609.06906v1 Algorithm3.3 terminal branch and recursive update; Theorem6.5 stagewise execution
target_statement: On explicit states (b,u,k,h) with nonnegative precision b,center u,step count k and a sequence h storing the k most recent observations, take a measurable positive current-state variance a and a positive terminal precision threshold. Construct the actual precision-weighted update, increment k and prepend the observation. For arbitrary actual observation and terminal Markov kernels Q,L, construct a Markov state transition which is identity on terminal states and is the Q-pushforward under that explicit update elsewhere. Construct measurable probability output kernels R_n with R_0=L and R_(n+1)(s)=L(s) on terminal states, otherwise the integral of R_n(updated(s,y)) against Q(s). Construct the finite full trajectory law and prove its terminal-output marginal equals this recursive output. Use StateDependentRGO to construct actual target and ideal observation kernels; for Q=H and L=T prove every finite output R_n(s)=T(s), deriving posterior consistency from the actual update rather than assuming recovery. No deterministic schedule is imposed.
